purpose: Bind the newly generated v8 clean-room source, its source-assigned communication lineage, the regenerated 500-scenario population and the now-admissible exact focal transfer split before any provider call; replace the proved-infeasible exact item/byte/token equality rule with a common exact-token ceiling and whole-record materialization.

base_protocol.inheritance: All v3 provisions remain binding except its unmet explicit-thread assessment, its source/scenario/transfer content commitments, and the v2 exact item/byte/token equality and truncating material-fit rules inherited through v3. This document replaces those provisions. Arms, questions, metrics, model plan, statistical estimands and all remaining hard gates are unchanged.

communication_thread_contract.assignment_basis: Deterministic UUIDv5 of seed plus the explicit focal business root. No subject, participant, question-text or similarity inference is permitted.

duplicate_rules.exact: same message ID, root, thread, reply parent and bytes as its source
duplicate_rules.near: new deterministic message ID, same root/thread, explicit reply to its source, changed bytes

budget_contract_amendment.feasibility_finding: Exact equality of item_count, utf8_byte_count and provider_token_count across semantically different evidence arms is not generally attainable using whole records. Attaining it would require prohibited filler or semantic truncation, so the inherited exact-equality rule is infeasible and superseded before execution.
budget_contract_amendment.retained_measurement_scope: The exact canonical JSON evidence array placed in the provider request.

shared_provider_token_ceiling.rule: One numeric ceiling measured by the bound exact provider tokenizer is frozen before the first call and applied identically to every evidence-bearing arm, scenario, variant and repeat. E0 remains the canonical empty array.
shared_provider_token_ceiling.selection: Treatment-blind deterministic ordering followed by whole-record inclusion only while the next complete semantic record fits beneath the ceiling.

reporting.primary_analysis: Registered paired Semantic Strict contrasts under the common ceiling, with no length-based exclusions.
reporting.length_sensitivity: Report paired effects with actual provider tokens, items and UTF-8 bytes as preregistered covariates and in fixed length bins; treat this as sensitivity analysis rather than manufactured equality.

execution_lock.reason: This amendment closes the source/thread/transfer gate and corrects the infeasible budget rule. Provider calls remain prohibited until a numeric common ceiling and whole-record material matrix, plus every inherited negative-evidence, signing, model, prompt and smoke-prefix gate, pass in one immutable signed preexecution manifest.
execution_lock.change_rule: Any material change to the bound v8 source, scenario population, focal split or inherited protocol requires preregistration v5 before execution.

self_digest_algorithm: sha256(canonical-json(document-without-self_sha256); UTF-8; keys sorted; separators comma+colon; ensure_ascii=false)
